risks.quote: Generative AI will repeat and amplify bias within the data on which it was trained.
Most large language models (LLMs) are designed to continuously learn from the data that is collected from user input
As it is impossible to know which sources are used in generative AI tools, they may reproduce misinterpretations or contain inaccurate data, irrelevant or out-dated information.

Generative AI tools re-present information developed by others in novel ways and so there is the risk of plagiarised content being submitted by a user as their own (which is also plagiarism), and artwork used by image generators may have been included without the creator’s consent or licence.
Further ethical concerns relate to the intense energy costs of AI processing
the implications for human labour and exploitation, often outsourced to the Global South
